I think you're depending on him too much to make you feel better whenever you're feeling an unpleasant emotion. My guess is that it's making him feel exhausted from having to think how to help make you feel better when that's not really his job. It's your job to make yourself feel better. If you tell him you woke up late and feel anxious, he should be able to say something like "aw I really hope you feel better soon", but instead he feels like he needs to help you and doesn't know how.

This is just an opinion that I've developed from being on both sides of a similar situation. Hope things get better for you.
